<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break a halide and form a ketone, which matches a Friedel‑Crafts acylation (halide removed, new C‑C bond to a carbonyl). No additional bond criteria are needed.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CCl)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
